matrix_payload: response_matrices/*.npz (one compressed K/H archive per frozen phase, mode, and grid; 3072 archives also contain J_phi)

response_definitions.K: c=Ka; q_p=1/sqrt(pixel area), a_p=E_source sqrt(pixel area) t_p; K dimensionless
response_definitions.H: c=Ht; H=K diag(E_source sqrt(pixel area)), sqrt(W) per unit command
response_definitions.M_H: [Re H; Im H] real command response

measurement_contract.phase_svd_global_phase_projection: raw spectrum is retained; only shape spectrum may remove one common output global-phase direction

claim_limits: pixel-level amplitude controllability is an upper bound for a future input interface, not semantic or measured camera observability
mathematical singular rank is not detector-noise-limited experimental dimension
Gaussian is the main reference and LP01 is a same-field model sensitivity check, not an independently optimized upper bound
all fiber/mode/optics parameters remain unmeasured simulation assumptions
finite v6 phase candidates do not establish global optimization or a physical channel-capacity bound

scientific_decision.interpretation: Supports planning a frozen four-vs-nine decoder/camera interface comparison only when both four- and nine-channel phase candidates and phase-Jacobian checks are numerically qualified; 100-channel qualification is reported separately. It does not select an OLS dimension or establish camera observability.
scientific_decision.permitted_next_action: repair or repeat only invalid numerical checks; do not infer capacity from failed measurements
